references.text: Moses commands that Achan and all his possessions be burned with fire, which shows the same pattern of burning what is under the ban.
Achan and all his possessions were burned with fire in the Valley of Achor as punishment for taking some of the devoted things from Jericho.
Describes how silver, gold, bronze, and iron were to be consecrated to the Lord and brought into the treasury of the Lord.
The law that cities under the ban are to be burned with fire, and no plunder is to be kept.
Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap of ruins, following the same practice as with Jericho.
Joshua defeated Hazor and burned it with fire, showing the same pattern of destroying Canaanite cities.
Gold, silver, bronze, iron, and other metals were to be purified by fire and brought as plunder to the Lord.
